title: Outward address checks
what: The check every outward request passes: a private, loopback or non-routable address refused before it is asked, each redirect hop checked as it is connected. Lives in src/web/address.rs.

title: Real Chrome reading
what: The standard Chrome a fetch falls back to and a site tool renders in: its profile, places, display, proxy and DevTools connection. Lives in src/web/chrome/.

title: Web reading forms
what: The forms a web read answers in, below the web layer and the site contract: failure kinds, errors and results, search hits and engine health, the fetch ceiling, the slice of a text and the page text normalised. Lives in src/forms/.

title: Per-host pacing
what: The pause held between two requests to one host and between two engine queries, against a deadline, so one investigation never hammers a site. Lives in src/web/pacing.rs and clock.rs.

title: PDF reading
what: A PDF read as its text page by page, or in its layout so a table keeps its rows apart. Lives in src/web/pdf.rs.

title: Picture reading
what: An image file read into a picture a model can be shown, rasters and AVIF decoded and scaled. Lives in src/web/picture.rs and src/web/picture/.

title: Search engines
what: The web search over the engine roster: each engine asked and its results parsed, engines that stop answering set aside, and the hits merged under the search bounds. Lives in src/web/search/.

title: Direct web session
what: One investigation's direct reading: a browser-shaped client with its cookie jar and identity, each page classified, and Chrome opened after a blocked direct read. Lives in src/web/session.rs, client.rs and their neighbours.
